items.title: Awesome WSL
items.content_text:
### WSL Tools / WSL Utilities

*   *   [hvcam (⭐0)](https://github.com/santleme/hvcam) - Stream a Windows webcam into WSL2 over Hyper-V sockets via Media Foundation — no kernel rebuild or usbipd required. ![github project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sirredbeard/Awesome-WSL/master/github-icon.png)

### WSL Tools / WSL-Specific Development Tools

*   [nvright (⭐3)](https://github.com/johnright/nvright) - A low-latency Neovim GUI for Windows that runs `nvim` inside a WSL distro. Windows clipboard and drag and drop, and a new window in any installed distro. ![github project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sirredbeard/Awesome-WSL/master/github-icon.png)
*   [kosa8](https://kosa8.com) - Commercial sandboxes for AI coding agents. On Windows 11 x86-64, `kosa8 wsl setup` installs its Linux engine into an Ubuntu WSL2 distribution and connects the Windows CLI to it, so agents run in sealed sandboxes that can be snapshotted and forked (preview).

items.content_text:
### Projects / AI Gateway

*   [agentgateway (⭐6.3k) (⭐6k)](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
*   [Bifrost (⭐9.8k) (⭐9.6k)](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.
*   [Envoy AI Gateway (⭐2.4k) (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/envoyproxy/ai-gateway) - An open-source gateway built on Envoy Proxy to manage request traffic from application clients to GenAI services with unified API access and usage limits.

*   [Camel K (⭐938) (⭐937)](https://github.com/apache/camel-k) - Lightweight Kubernetes-native integration platform built on Apache Camel that runs integration routes directly on Kubernetes and OpenShift as cloud-native serverless services.

*   [Apache Iggy (⭐5.3k) (⭐5.3k)](https://github.com/apache/iggy) - Persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, supporting QUIC, TCP, and HTTP transports with high throughput and low latency.
*   [Centrifugo (⭐11k) (⭐11k)](https://github.com/centrifugal/centrifugo) - Scalable real-time messaging server that minimizes delay in delivering events to online users.

### Projects / Schema Registry

*   [Apicurio Registry (⭐961) (⭐950)](https://github.com/Apicurio/apicurio-registry) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.
*   [Karapace (⭐641) (⭐640)](https://github.com/Aiven-Open/karapace) - Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

### Projects / Self-Service Integration

*   [n8n (⭐211k) (⭐210k)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

### Projects / Stream Processing

*   [ksqlDB (⭐318) (⭐318)](https://github.com/confluentinc/ksql) - Database purpose-built for stream processing applications on Kafka, queried with SQL.
*   [Redpanda Connect (⭐8.8k) (⭐8.8k)](https://github.com/redpanda-data/connect) - Declarative stream processor and connector toolkit (formerly Benthos) for transforming and routing data between systems.

### Projects / Workflow Engine

*   [Restate (⭐4.7k) (⭐4.7k)](https://github.com/restatedev/restate) - Durable execution engine for building resilient workflows, event-driven services, and stateful handlers as plain code.

*   [Arazzo Specification (⭐492) (⭐489)](https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification) - A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.

*   [YAML (⭐512) (⭐509)](https://github.com/yaml/yaml-spec) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

items.title: Awesome Analytics
items.content_text:
### General analytics

*   [Eventkiwi](https://eventkiwi.com/) - Event aggregation and reporting platform: send events from any service through one HTTP API and get scheduled reports, with an AI summary built on exact counts, by email or Telegram. `©` `SaaS`
*   [North Metric](https://www.northmetric.io/) - Churn analytics for SaaS on Stripe. Scores each customer's churn risk and ranks them by revenue at risk. `©` `SaaS`

### SEO

*   [Firecrawl Alexandria](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/categories/web-analytics-marketing) - Website traffic and engagement (Similarweb) and Wayback Machine snapshots as tools AI agents can call through one Firecrawl API key, CLI or MCP server. `©` `SaaS`

### Privacy focused analytics

*   [Owlytics](https://kyrylo.org/owlytics) - Small, cookieless web analytics with one Rust executable and one SQLite database. No stored raw IP addresses. ([Source Code (⭐5)](https://github.com/kyrylo/owlytics)) `MIT` `Self-Hosted` `Rust`
*   [Highseat](https://highseat.com/) - Cookieless web analytics with revenue by source: connects to your payment provider and shows which traffic sources bring paying customers. Public API and MCP server. `©` `SaaS`

### Analytics layers

*   [hypequery](https://hypequery.com) - Open-source embedded analytics layer for ClickHouse. Define metrics and dimensions once in TypeScript or Python, then serve them as type-safe queries, authenticated HTTP APIs, React hooks and MCP tools for AI agents from your own backend. ([Source Code (⭐106)](https://github.com/hypequery/hypequery)) `Apache-2.0` `TypeScript/Python`

### Attribution tracking

*   [Improvado](https://improvado.io/) - Marketing analytics platform that combines ad, web analytics and CRM data for cross-channel reporting and attribution, with an MCP server for AI agents. `©` `SaaS`

### Social media analytics

*   [Social Fetch](https://www.socialfetch.dev) - Social media data API: public profiles, posts, comments and transcripts from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit and LinkedIn as JSON. `©` `SaaS`

### Developer analytics

*   [Aidealy](https://aidealy.ai) - Measures the productivity of engineers and AI agents from the code they ship: a rank per engineer, how much of the code AI wrote, and AI token cost per pull request. `©` `SaaS`
*   [Weave](https://weaveos.com/) - Engineering analytics for code output, review quality, and AI-tool usage and costs. `©` `SaaS`

### Analytics dashboards

*   [Web-to-Web BI Board](https://www.roimobi.com/open-source/cohort-roas-ltv-dashboard) - Cohort ROAS and LTV dashboard for subscription web funnels: payback from day 0 to day 360, sBG forecasts with 80 % intervals, real-time spend and a funnel map. Static, reads one JSON file, no backend. ([Demo](https://ua5er.github.io/web2web-bi-board/), [Source Code (⭐0)](https://github.com/ua5er/web2web-bi-board)) `MIT` `JavaScript`

items.title: Awesome LaTeX
items.content_text:
### Engines

*   [XeTeX](https://xetex.sourceforge.net) - TeX compiler that provides better unicode and font support than TeX/pdfTeX (i.e. you can use the fonts of your operating system instead of only TeX fonts). ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)
*   [SwiftLaTeX (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/SwiftLaTeX/SwiftLaTeX) - pdfTeX and XeTeX compiled to WebAssembly, so you can compile LaTeX entirely in the browser or embed a TeX engine in a webpage. ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)

### LaTeX formulas on the web

*   [MathJax](https://www.mathjax.org) - JavaScript engine to render mathematical formulas on the web. The outcome looks really slick. ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)
*   [KaTeX](https://katex.org) - Math rendering library made by Khan Academy focusing on fast load times. All output is processed as plain HTML instead of fixed images. ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)
*   [MathLive](https://mathlive.io/) - Web component for editing and displaying math with LaTeX, including virtual keyboards and MathML/speech export. ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)

### LaTeX-focused

*   [BakomaTex](https://bakoma-tex.com) - Commercial LaTeX editor that allows to edit your document both using its source code and WYSIWYG.
*   [Gummi (⭐802)](https://github.com/alexandervdm/gummi) - Simple GTK LaTeX editor with a continuously updating live preview pane. ![linux](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/linux.svg) ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)
*   [Texpile](https://texpile.com) - Free and open-source desktop editor that edits LaTeX visually (like LyX) or by source with IntelliSense, with local compilation and built-in Git. Also supports Typst and Markdown. ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)
*   [LaTeX Editor (⭐34)](https://github.com/s-balli/latex-editor) - Single-executable desktop editor with live PDF preview, two-way SyncTeX, LaTeX-aware spell checking, and one-key project snapshots written as a standard Git repository. Needs a separate TeX distribution. ![windows](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/windows.svg) ![linux](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/linux.svg) ![foss](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/foss.svg)
*   [ModernTex](https://purplelink.llc/moderntex/) - Native macOS LaTeX editor for academic writing, with synced source and PDF, plain-language error messages, submission-readiness checks, a visual TikZ designer and a table editor. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time $19.99. ![mac](https://github.com/egeerardyn/awesome-LaTeX/raw/master/fig/apple.svg)

### Online editors

### Multiple languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   [REA](https://rea.tools/) — Local CLI and MCP server for static analysis of native binaries, .NET assemblies, and JavaScript and Electron bundles. Reports binary hardening flags, dependencies, and release exposure such as shipped source maps, with supporting evidence. The release audit can fail a build at a chosen severity.

### Other / [Other](#other-1)

*   [glsec](https://glsec.github.io) — Static analysis for GitLab CI/CD pipeline files (.gitlab-ci.yml), detecting insecure patterns such as unpinned includes, components and images, leaked secrets, injection through pipeline inputs and job scripts, unsafe deployments, and supply-chain risks. Runs as a CLI, pre-commit hook, CI step, or GitLab CI/CD component.
*   [GuardLink](https://guardlink.bugb.io/) — Continuous threat modeling as code. Security annotations in source comments (threats, exposures, mitigations, flows) form a threat model that updates with the code and is validated and diffed against the base branch in CI. Without an LLM, it reports untrusted-entry-to-sink paths with no control, citing file:line, and tracks which claims are verified or stale. Open exposures become test templates to prove them. Any comment syntax; coding agents maintain it via MCP. Optional LLM threat reports.
*   [djLint](https://djlint.com) — Linter and formatter for HTML templates. It understands the template syntax together with the markup and has profiles for Django, Jinja, Twig, Nunjucks, Handlebars, Mustache, Liquid, Go templates, Angular, Tera, Askama and Mako. The linter reports accessibility, correctness and style problems. Runs as a CLI, a language server (LSP), a pre-commit hook and a VS Code extension.

items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [ChronoStack (⭐1)](https://github.com/Asmodeus14/ChronoStack) - Open-source CLI that moves time forward across a Docker Compose stack (Postgres, Redis and your services together, no code changes) to test trials, renewals, scheduled jobs and outages in virtual time, with scenarios, seeded simulated users and JUnit reports.

### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [Mockatoo](https://mockatoo.globalunderdog.com) - Free hosted mock OAuth provider for Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Apple and four other providers, so E2E tests in Playwright, Cypress or CI can sign in without real accounts, CAPTCHAs or app registration.
*   [ShipShape (⭐0)](https://github.com/Shadysmetools/shipshape) - Open-source (MIT) Claude Code plugin that turns a plain-language goal into Playwright browser tests, runs each scenario twice to flag flaky results, and writes an offline HTML report with recorded video.
*   [sitelooper (⭐1)](https://github.com/restspace/sitelooper) - Open-source (MIT) CLI that records a browser flow from plain-English steps with an LLM agent, then compiles it into a standalone Playwright spec that runs in CI with no model, and repairs the spec when the app changes.

### Software / Test Report Diagnostics

*   [Playwright State Lens (⭐5)](https://github.com/aichance/business-ai-recipes/tree/main/tools/playwright-state-lens) - Experimental Playwright helper showing selected browser-storage field changes and step screenshots in one local HTML report.
*   [pytest-glow-report (⭐4)](https://github.com/godhiraj-code/pytest-glow-report) - Open source (MIT) pytest plugin that writes HTML and JSON reports and keeps run history in SQLite.

### Server Software / General Purpose

*   [FreeSWITCH (⭐5.3k)](https://github.com/signalwire/freeswitch) - Open source communications server for voice, video, messaging and conferencing.

*   [Kamailio](https://www.kamailio.org/w/) - Open source SIP server for routing, registration, presence and large-scale deployments.

*   [AstriCon](https://www.asterisk.org/astricon/) - Conference for Asterisk and FreePBX developers and users.

*   [TADHack](https://blog.tadhack.com/) - Telecom application hackathons, demos and event announcements.

*   [Awesome Asterisk (⭐13)](https://github.com/ictinnovations/awesome-asterisk) - Asterisk tooling: ARI, AMI and AGI libraries, call audio streaming, voice AI and testing.

### Drug Response & Perturbation

*   [scCT-DB](http://scctdb.ncpsb.org.cn) — Cancer treatment single-cell database with 266 paired pre/post-treatment datasets, 6.19M cells, 1,142 samples, 27 cancer types, and 102 drugs.
*   [scICB](http://www.scimmnue.com/) — Pan-cancer ICB therapy single-cell database spanning 338 patients, 807 samples, 3.69M cells, and 13 cancer types, including 247 matched pre/post-treatment patients.
*   [CellResDB](https://cellknowledge.com.cn/cellresponse) — Cancer therapy response single-cell database containing 4.7M cells from 1,391 patient samples, 72 datasets, and 24 cancer types.
*   [Gondal et al. 2025 ICB scRNA-seq collection](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/61e422dd-c9cd-460e-9b91-72d9517348ef) — Integrated ICB-treated cancer single-cell collection from eight studies and 223 patients, with 90,270 cancer cells and 265,671 other cells.

### Genetic Perturbation & Perturb-seq

*   [scPerturbBench (TianGzlab / PerturbArena) (⭐11)](https://github.com/TianGzlab/scPerturbBench) — Benchmark of single-cell genetic perturbation prediction covering unseen perturbations, combinations, cell-state transfer, and 24 evaluation metrics.
*   [scPerturBench (BM2 Lab) (⭐110)](https://github.com/bm2-lab/scPerturBench) — Benchmark comparing 27 single-cell perturbation-response prediction methods across 29 genetic and chemical perturbation datasets.

### General Biological ML & Knowledge Graph Benchmarks

*   [CellBench (CellVoyager) (⭐273)](https://github.com/zou-group/CellVoyager/tree/main/CellBench) — Benchmark for evaluating LLMs and data-analysis agents on reproducible single-cell research tasks.

### Preprocessing Tools

*   [SpatialData](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/) — Interoperable data structures and tooling for spatial omics, microscopy images, coordinates, segmentation shapes, and annotations.

### Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

*   [CellVoyager (⭐273)](https://github.com/zou-group/CellVoyager) — Jupyter-based scientific agent that plans, executes, and evaluates single-cell transcriptomics analyses, accompanied by CellBench.

### Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

*   [Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale (⭐896)](https://github.com/vandijklab/cell2sentence) — Single-cell language-model family representing gene-expression profiles as cell sentences for cellular interpretation, generation, and question answering.

### Multi-Modal Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

*   [TxGemma](https://deepmind.google/models/gemma/txgemma/) — Open Gemma-based therapeutic-development model family (2B, 9B, and 27B) for property prediction and interactive scientific reasoning.
*   [NVIDIA Nemotron for Science](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-introduces-nemotron-for-science-to-accelerate-discoveries-with-agents) — Scientific-agent development stack based on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with post-training recipes and chemistry reasoning benchmark LitmusBench v0.2.

items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [ai-cmd (kylesnowschwartz) (⭐108)](https://github.com/kylesnowschwartz/zsh-ai-cmd) - Converts natural language to shell commands with ghost text preview. Requires `curl`, [`jq`](https://stedolan.github.io/jq/) and an Anthropic API key.
*   [ai-cmd (shanemcd) (⭐8)](https://github.com/shanemcd/ai-cmd) - Generate shell commands from natural language using LLMs via [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) or [Ollama](https://ollama.ai/).
*   [apathy (⭐0)](https://github.com/sifex/apathy) - A terminal-to-agent zsh CLI that converts your pasted LLM prompts into actual invokes of harnesses like OpenCode, Claude Code and more. It manages to tell the difference between commands meant for your terminal, and prompts meant for your agent, as well as retain what you previously typed in your terminal.
*   [auto-venv (⭐7)](https://github.com/Skylor-Tang/auto-venv) - Automatically activates the Python virtual environment in the current directory or its parent directories.
*   [copylast (⭐0)](https://github.com/salimmohamed/copylast) - Reads the last command's output straight out of [tmux](https://tmux.app/)'s scrollback, so it's instant and you get exactly what you saw.
*   [fzf-unified (⭐0)](https://github.com/ooodnakov/zsh-fzf-unified) - A single managed source of truth for everything fzf inside ZSH: shell integration (Ctrl-T / Alt-C), history search (Ctrl-R), [ripgrep (⭐70k)](https://github.com/burntsushi/ripgrep) live grep (Ctrl-G), Tab completion (fzf-tab, vendored) and the Up/Down arrow policy — one plugin instead of several loosely-coupled ones fighting over the same keybindings.
*   [git-sweep (⭐1)](https://github.com/rosado-io/zsh-git-sweep) - Small ZSH plugin for cleaning up Git branches and worktrees, with protected branch patterns, dry-run previews, optional interactive selection, and explicit remote cleanup.
*   [shellsense (ThePubDoc) (⭐1)](https://github.com/ThePubDoc/shellsense) - IDE-style autocomplete for your terminal. Type a command and a list of what can come next opens under the word you are typing: subcommands, options, git branches, npm scripts, files and folders, each with a short description. Pick one with the arrow keys or keep typing to narrow the list.
*   [shellsense (venopyX) (⭐7)](https://github.com/venopyX/shellsense) - AI-powered ZSH plugin designed to enhance your terminal experience with powerful features and AI-powered capabilities. Developed using Python, ShellSense offers a streamlined workflow for various tasks, making your terminal more efficient and user-friendly.
*   [wslpath (⭐1)](https://github.com/Tenko-Star/zsh-wslpath) - Convert a Windows path on the WSL ZSH command line by pressing Tab. Pasting or dragging a path into the terminal does not change it. The plugin uses WSL's wslpath and only replaces the path if the file or directory exists.

### Themes / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [hexagon (⭐5)](https://github.com/dio-az/hexagon) - Minimalist ZSH theme based on [geometry (⭐1k)](https://github.com/geometry-zsh/geometry).

items.content_text:
### Pomodoro / Enterprise Git Service

*   [Yellow Tomato](https://yellowtomato.app/) (`Chrome`,`iOS`): Pomodoro timer that blocks distracting sites and apps only during focus sessions, with a task list and focus stats \[Free].

*   [Lacuna](https://lacuna.tiptreesystems.com): Search 2.3 million ML and AI papers, the researchers behind them, and the research directions they form; free, no account, with a read-only [MCP server (⭐70)](https://github.com/tiptreesystems/lacuna-research-mcp) for AI assistants.

### Open Science / HTML+CSS+JS

*   [AutoResearch](https://autoresearch.me/en/): Browser-based AI research system that connects literature exploration, research ideas, model implementation, GPU experiments and manuscript drafting. Private beta: apply on the site, wait for administrator approval, then set a password from the follow-up email and sign in; approved members receive 5,000 starter credits. Official pages say access is free during the beta, but this is a limited allowance, not unlimited use and not access without an account. Prices for future plans are not yet announced.

*   [AudioMIDI](https://audiomidi.app/) - Converts short melodies or solo-instrument audio into editable MIDI with browser note preview and export; no-signup Quick mode and three free Deep transcriptions per day. `#free` `#music` `#midi`
*   [BeatMusic](https://beatmusic.ai/) - AI music generator that turns a text idea or your lyrics into full songs with vocals. `#freemium`

*   [Alter Ego](https://cloudalterego.cafeboon.com) - One memory for all your AI chats, in Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and any other AI chat, logged automatically and kept in your own cloud storage. `#mcp` `#memory`

*   [QuelLLM](https://quelllm.fr/) - Browser-based calculator and configurator for comparing local AI models against available hardware; results are estimates and the tool does not infer responses. `#free` `#productivity`

### Psychology

*   [Adoree](https://adoree.ai/) - AI relationship assistant for couples where each partner talks privately, helping you both communicate without escalating. `#freemium`

### Search Engine

*   [search-console-mcp (⭐8)](https://github.com/sudomichael/search-console-mcp) - Google Search Console for any MCP client - 30-second login, no Google Cloud project. Read-only. `#opensource` `#mcp`

### Translation

*   [GuruTrans](https://gurutrans.app/) - AI translation tools for languages, old English styles, and Morse code. Registered users get 5 free translations a day. `#freemium` `#translation`

### Travel

*   [CheapCarRent](https://cheapcarent.com/) - Official hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for car rental search at 15,000 pickup points in 46 countries, 19 languages. No API key, read-only. `#free` `#mcp` `#opensource`

### Video

*   [BeatMV](https://beatmv.ai/) - AI music video generator that turns any song into a music video that moves with the beat. `#freemium`
*   [Cuecaps](https://cuecaps.com/) - Animated word-by-word captions for Shorts, TikTok and Reels, transcribed and rendered in the browser so the video never uploads; exports MP4, transparent overlays and SRT/VTT. `#freemium`
*   [PawMambo](https://pawmambo.com/) - Creates short AI dog dance videos from a dog photo and a dance-reference video. `#freemium` `#video` `#pets`
*   [Twistavo](https://twistavo.com/) - AI video studio to replace a person or character in an existing clip (Scene Recast) and run video and image models; monthly plans from $3.99. `#paid`

items.content_text:
### Applications

*   [lthoangg/openagentd (⭐216)](https://github.com/lthoangg/openagentd) - A local coding agent as a desktop app (Tauri) and CLI with a native Rust backend; shows every tool call, diff and shell command, and works with your own model keys or local models [![CI](https://github.com/lthoangg/openagentd/actions/workflows/appv3.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/lthoangg/openagentd/actions/workflows/appv3.yml)
*   [vey-proxy (⭐51)](https://github.com/VEY-OSS/vey) - Modular async Rust proxy daemon unifying HTTP/SOCKS forward proxying, HTTP/TLS reverse proxying, TPROXY/SNI transparent proxying, TCP/UDP/TLS stream proxying, dynamic egress routing, TLS/ICAP inspection, and hot reloads. [![CodeCoverage](https://github.com/VEY-OSS/vey/actions/workflows/codecov.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/VEY-OSS/vey/actions)
*   [VinceGHER/openwren (⭐94)](https://github.com/VinceGHER/openwren) - Privacy-first desktop mail client for Gmail and IMAP that keeps mail encrypted on your computer, built with Tauri [![CI](https://github.com/VinceGHER/openwren/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/VinceGHER/openwren/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Audio and Music

*   [openwave-studio/opendj (⭐221)](https://github.com/openwave-studio/opendj) - Fast, modern DJ and mixing app for macOS, Windows and Linux, with MIDI/HID controller support, stems, key lock, plugin hosting (CLAP/VST3/AU) and library import from rekordbox, VirtualDJ and djay Pro [![CI](https://github.com/openwave-studio/opendj/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/openwave-studio/opendj/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Emulators

*   Gameboy
    *   [dquigles/terminal\_gameboy (⭐82)](https://github.com/dquigles/terminal_gameboy) \[[terminal\_gameboy](https://crates.io/crates/terminal_gameboy)] - Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator that runs in the terminal, with ASCII and Unicode block rendering and sound
    *   [Gekkio/mooneye-gb (⭐972)](https://github.com/Gekkio/mooneye-gb) - A Game Boy research project and emulator
    *   [joamag/boytacean (⭐683)](https://github.com/joamag/boytacean) - GameBoy Color emulator that runs on the Web using WebAssembly.
    *   [mohanson/gameboy (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/mohanson/gameboy) - Full featured Cross-platform GameBoy emulator. Forever boys!.
    *   [mvdnes/rboy (⭐667)](https://github.com/mvdnes/rboy) - A Gameboy Emulator

### Applications / File manager

*   [Koimsurai/Arke (⭐232)](https://github.com/Koimsurai/Arke) - A file explorer for Windows that never freezes, GPU-rendered with GPUI [![CI](https://github.com/Koimsurai/Arke/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Koimsurai/Arke/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Productivity

*   [stevyhacker/LokalBot (⭐119)](https://github.com/stevyhacker/LokalBot) - Private local-first meeting notes (no bot), dictation, inline autocomplete, screen recall, and read-only MCP server with a native Rust + GPUI desktop app for Linux and Windows. [![Linux & Windows](https://github.com/stevyhacker/LokalBot/actions/workflows/linux-windows.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/stevyhacker/LokalBot/actions/workflows/linux-windows.yml)

### Applications / Social networks

*   XMPP
    *   [lonewolf-im/lonewolf (⭐109)](https://github.com/lonewolf-im/lonewolf) - A standalone XMPP server [![CI](https://github.com/lonewolf-im/lonewolf/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/lonewolf-im/lonewolf/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Utilities

*   [Multron-Community/Multron-Download-Manager (⭐25)](https://github.com/Multron-Community/Multron-Download-Manager) - Cross-platform download manager built with Tauri that splits files into parallel connections, with browser integration, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and BitTorrent support.
*   [PaperPilot (⭐786)](https://github.com/KrushnaVardhanReddy/PaperPilot) - Privacy-first, local document toolkit, WebAssembly engine, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in pure Rust. [![CI](https://github.com/KrushnaVardhanReddy/PaperPilot/actions/workflows/rust.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/KrushnaVardhanReddy/PaperPilot/actions)

### Applications / Virtualization

*   [libracoder/kiri (⭐11k)](https://github.com/libracoder/kiri) - A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Docker images in a tiny Linux VM and speaks the Docker Engine API [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/libracoder/kiri)](https://github.com/libracoder/kiri/releases)

### Development tools / Workflow Automation

*   [HyunSeob/iphone-cli (⭐109)](https://github.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli) \[[iphone-cli](https://crates.io/crates/iphone-cli)] - Single-binary CLI and MCP server letting AI agents read and operate apps on a real iPhone (iOS 27+) via the accessibility tree without Xcode or WebDriverAgent. [![CI](https://github.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
*   [mokevnin/heavy (⭐55)](https://github.com/mokevnin/heavy) \[[heavy](https://crates.io/crates/heavy)] - A machine-wide counting semaphore for heavy commands: tests, type checks and builds started by parallel coding agents and checkouts take turns instead of starving the machine [![CI](https://github.com/mokevnin/heavy/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/mokevnin/heavy/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Development tools / Static analysis

*   [mokevnin/easement (⭐57)](https://github.com/mokevnin/easement) \[[easement](https://crates.io/crates/easement)] - Architecture quality gate for polyglot codebases: declare components and their allowed dependencies, and fail the build when Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Java or other code drifts from them [![CI](https://github.com/mokevnin/easement/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/mokevnin/easement/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Development tools / Transpiling

*   [erkamyaman/rust-anything (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/erkamyaman/rust-anything) \[[rust-anything](https://crates.io/crates/rust-anything)] - Ports TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java apps to Rust piece by piece, checking each piece against the recorded behavior of the original. [![build badge](https://github.com/erkamyaman/rust-anything/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/erkamyaman/rust-anything/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Audio and Music

*   [gradium-ai/xn-ptts (⭐509)](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts) \[[ptts](https://crates.io/crates/ptts)] - Streaming inference for Phonon text-to-speech models on CPU, GPU, mobile devices, and browsers [![Rust CI](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts/actions/workflows/rust-ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts/actions/workflows/rust-ci.yml)

### Libraries / Configuration

*   [hyperi-io/scalo-rs (⭐0)](https://github.com/hyperi-io/scalo-rs) \[[scalo](https://crates.io/crates/scalo)] - Runtime for Rust services. It has layered config, redacted structured logs and health probes. It supports Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics. Its transports are Kafka, gRPC and HTTP.

### Libraries / Data visualization

*   [dataviz-rs/dataviz (⭐10)](https://github.com/dataviz-rs/dataviz) \[[dataviz](https://crates.io/crates/dataviz)] - Fast plotting library with 120+ chart types (statistics, finance, genomics, maps, 3D), interactive windows, PNG/SVG/PDF/HTML output, and Python, JavaScript and C/C++ bindings. [![CI](https://github.com/dataviz-rs/dataviz/actions/workflows/rust.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/dataviz-rs/dataviz/actions/workflows/rust.yml)

### Libraries / Home automation

*   [mihai-dinculescu/tapo (⭐877)](https://github.com/mihai-dinculescu/tapo) \[[tapo](https://crates.io/crates/tapo)] - Client for TP-Link Tapo smart devices (plugs, lights, hubs, sensors and cameras), with Python bindings and an MCP server [![Tapo Rust](https://github.com/mihai-dinculescu/tapo/actions/workflows/tapo-rs.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/mihai-dinculescu/tapo/actions/workflows/tapo-rs.yml)

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/aqilc/ClaudeTTY) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ilhamnadhif/ternarycode) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/raistlinsha-plus/inkstone) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

  • mm2t - Meeting recorder with local storage and on-device speaker recognition, using your chosen services for transcripts and summaries.
  • Stelix - Live stem separation for your Mac: splits what any app is playing into vocals, drums, bass and other in real time, so you can turn each one up or down or hear it alone, all on-device.

Download Management Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Multron Download Manager (⭐25) - Multi-connection download manager with yt-dlp and BitTorrent support.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Point - Open-source push-to-talk dictation that also lets you circle part of the screen while you talk, sending your words plus a marked-up screenshot to Claude Code, Cursor, or any chat, transcribed on-device.
  • Purr - Open-source on-device dictation that types into any app with Parakeet or Whisper, plus meeting notes with speaker labels and summaries.
  • VoxtMini - Voice input on local models: transcribe, translate and rewrite by voice in any app, in English, Chinese and Japanese.
  • WhisPaste - Push-to-talk dictation for macOS, Windows and Linux that transcribes on-device with Whisper or Parakeet and pastes the text at the cursor in any app.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Meridian - Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium with spaces, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click Arc and Chrome import, and a built-in MCP server for AI agents.

Translation Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Tomoru - Live bilingual subtitles for streams, anime, games, and meetings, plus instant screen text translation — works offline on your Mac or in the cloud, with glossaries that keep character names right.

Proxy and VPN Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • unbraid - Per-app VPN client. Each app can use its own exit or skip the VPN, while Tailscale stays on.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • Copia - Clipboard manager that keeps every copy and pastes several at once or one by one.
  • Tietie (⭐0) - Open-source clipboard history for Mac and Windows with number-key pasting and search for text inside images, with an interface in Traditional Chinese.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • AgentBar (⭐15) - Menu bar and notch status for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI), with one-click Allow or Deny for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot permission requests.
  • Bar27 (⭐19) - Menu bar manager for macOS 27 that hides icons per app and reveals them with a click, hover, or shortcut.
  • Convrt (⭐5) - Offline menu bar file converter: hold Shift while dragging files and drop them on a wheel that only shows the formats and tools that fit them, with a command-line version.
  • Deskbridge - Menu bar app that opens a Samsung Galaxy phone's DeX desktop in a Mac window over USB or Wi-Fi, with phone apps in their own windows, call banners and notifications.
  • DisplayLatch - Keeps external monitors connected after sleep and restart, with DDC brightness, resolution and disconnect-without-unplugging controls.
  • GravityNotch - Turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island with system HUDs that work on macOS Tahoe, a lock screen player with synced lyrics, clipboard history and live Claude Code agent tracking.
  • Music Router (⭐4) - Stops Music.app from auto-launching and routes media keys to the app you're actually using.
  • NotchDeck (⭐5) - Control center around the MacBook notch with system metrics, media controls, quick notes, screen recording and task profiles.
  • SIAM.AI GPU Watch (⭐0) - Menu bar app for monitoring NVIDIA GPUs across remote servers over SSH.
  • SoundLadder (⭐1) - Menu bar app that picks the audio output from a ranked list and falls back to the next connected device automatically.
  • YANA (⭐1) - Turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for media, volume and brightness HUDs, notifications, Messages, iPhone calls, calendar, weather, timers, and a file shelf.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • App Vanish - Drop an app on the bin to remove it and the files it left behind. Unsure files start unticked and everything goes to the Trash. The App Store edition finds leftovers of apps you already deleted.
  • Ebb (⭐4) - Open-source disk cleaner and AI-storage viewer for macOS, Windows and Linux that plans a cleanup you can read, moves removals to the Trash with a 90-day undo journal, and lets an MCP-capable AI client help without ever deleting on its own.

items.content_text:
### Source Code Repos

*   [Upstream](https://upstream.codes/) - Over 10,000 pushes/sec, the fastest Git host. 100 free repos, public or private, with LFS, merge checks, semantic code search, and AI

### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [Context.dev](https://www.context.dev/) - Web scraping API with 1,000 API credits per month (1,000 standard scrapes) plus 10,000 one-time Logo Link requests, no credit card required.
*   [CurrencyBeacon](https://currencybeacon.com/) - Realtime currency data API for fintech apps. The free plan includes 5,000 calls per month.
*   [CustomJS](https://www.customjs.space) - HTML to PDF or PDF to PNG/Text & PDF merging/extraction/merging APIs. Free tier has 600 calls a month.
*   [Kardinal](https://kardinal.ai/) - Route optimization API for delivery and field service fleets: multi-vehicle routing with time windows, vehicle capacities and other real-world constraints, also usable by AI agents. Free tier includes 1,000 stops that never expire, no credit card required.

### Tools for Teams and Collaboration

*   [Fibery](https://fibery.com/) - Connected workspace platform. Free for single users, up to 2 GB disk space.
*   [Notion](https://www.notion.com/) - Notion is a note-taking and collaboration application with markdown support that integrates tasks, wikis, and databases. The company describes the app as an all-in-one workspace for note-taking, project management and task management. In addition to cross-platform apps, it can be accessed via most web browsers.
*   [Stoat](https://stoat.chat/) - An OpenSource alternative for[Discord](https://discord.com/), that respects your privacy. It also have most proprietary features from discord for free. Stoat is a all in one application that is secure and fast, while being 100% free. every features are free. They also have (official & unofficial) plugins support unlike most main-stream chatting applications.
*   [zoom](https://zoom.com/) - Secure Video and Web conferencing add-ons available. The free plan is limited to 40 minutes.

### Code Generation

*   [v0](https://v0.app/) - Created by Vercel, v0 generates copy-and-paste friendly React code using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. The free plan includes 7 messages per day, Design Mode and GitHub sync.

### Code Quality

*   [DeepSource](https://deepsource.com/) - DeepSource continuously analyzes source code changes, finding and fixing issues categorized under security, performance, anti-patterns, bug-risks, documentation, and style. Native integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
*   [proofline.sh](https://proofline.sh/) - AI code review for GitHub pull requests, with infrastructure-aware checks when connected to a deployment environment. Free forever for open repos, and no subscription required if you BYOK on any private repo.
*   [SonarQube Cloud](https://sonarsouce.com) - Automated source code analysis for Java, JavaScript, C/C++, C#, VB.NET, PHP, Objective-C, Swift, Python, Groovy and even more languages, free for Open Source

### Security and PKI

*   [Chainguard](https://www.chainguard.dev/) - Hardened, minimal container images and a software supply chain security platform. The Starter plan is free with no credit card: five users, five container images, 50,000 dependency pulls and 100 GB of artifact storage per month.
*   [Safety](https://www.getsafety.com/) - Software supply chain security for Python, JavaScript and Docker dependencies. The free plan covers one codebase and 100 scans per month for a single user, for non-commercial use.
*   [tridentstack.com](https://tridentstack.com) - Patch, vulnerability and compliance management for Windows, macOS and Linux endpoints. Free forever for up to 200 endpoints with every feature included, no credit card required.

### Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

*   [Hexclave](https://stack-auth.com) - Open-source authentication that doesn't suck. The most developer-friendly solution, getting you started in just five minutes. Self-hostable for free, or offers a managed SaaS version with 10k free Monthly Active Users.

### Log Management

*   [Better Stack Logs](https://betterstack.com/log-management) - ClickHouse-based SQL-compatible log management. The free plan includes 3 GB of logs retained for three days.

### Monitoring

*   [Uptimeify](https://uptimeify.io/status-pages) - Permament free status pages including custom domain, subscribers (mail, slack, teams, webhook and rss) and maintenance with postmortems. Fully hosted inside the EU.

### Education and Career Development

*   [Cisco Networking Academy](https://netacad.com/) - Offers free certification-aligned courses in topics like cybersecurity, networking, and Python.

### Email

*   [addy.io](https://addy.io) - Open-source anonymous email forwarding, create unlimited email aliases for free
*   [Mailkube](https://mailkube.com/) - Email infrastructure for developers, 4,000 emails/month free, unlimited domains included
*   [turboSMTP](https://serversmtp.com) - SMTP relay service, free for 200 emails per day or 6000 emails per month, free forever, no time limit, no expiry. Web API, SPF/DKIM authentication, suppression management, 1 sending domain, 2 API keys, 2FA, ticket and chat support, GDPR compliant.

### Forms

*   [FormTango](https://formtango.com) - Form backend for static sites and AI-built apps. Free plan: 100 submissions a month, unlimited forms, spam filtering and email notifications. Endpoints can be created from the API with no account.
*   [Kwes.io](https://kwesforms.com/) - Feature rich form endpoint. Works great with static sites. The free plan includes up to 1 website with up to 50 monthly submissions.

### Generative AI

*   [Respan](https://www.respan.ai/) - LLM observability and gateway with one format for 200+ models. The free plan includes 100,000 logs, 1,000 scores, five datasets, two evaluators and ten prompts per month, with no credit card required.

### CDN and Protection

*   [ovh](https://www.ovhcloud.com/en-ie/security/ssl-gateway/) - Free DDoS protection and SSL certificate

### PaaS

*   [Ravion](https://www.ravion.com/) - Deploy web services, databases, and more on your own AWS account with a Git push style workflow. The Individuals plan is free for one user with up to 50 modules, 2,000 pipeline minutes and $20 of AI tokens per month. AWS costs are billed through AWS, but you can use credits and the AWS free tier.

### BaaS

*   [IFTTT](https://ifttt.ai/) - Automate your favorite apps and devices. Free 2 Applets

### Web Hosting

*   [readthedocs.com](https://readthedocs.com/) - Free documentation hosting with versioning, PDF generation, and more

### Managed Data Services

*   [CrateDB](https://cratedb.com/) - Distributed Open Source SQL database for real-time analytics. [Free Tier CRFREE](https://crate.io/lp-crfree): One-node with 2 CPUs, 2 GiB of memory, 8 GiB of storage. One cluster per organization, no payment method needed.
*   [Raff](https://rafftechnologies.com/products/managed-databases) - Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL and Valkey, 1 free database per account with no expiry, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 2 GB storage (Valkey: 512 MB memory), 20 direct and 200 pooled connections on PostgreSQL, TLS on every database, pauses after 7 days without connections and resumes in about a minute. No egress fees.
*   [SeaTable](https://seatable.com/) - Flexible, Spreadsheet-like Database built by the Seafile team. unlimited tables, 2,000 lines, 1-month versioning, up to 25 team members.

### Storage and Media Processing

*   [We.Team](https://www.we.team/en) - Encrypt, share, copy, and move all your cloud storage files from one place. The basic plan provides unlimited file transfer with 250 MB max. file size and allows five encrypted files
*   [QRdx](https://qrdx.dev) - Free Open-source QR code generator, plus an image API that needs no key (SVG, PNG, WebP or EPS). Free: unlimited static QR codes with no account, the image API up to 300 requests a minute, and 10 dynamic QR codes with scan analytics on a free account.
*   [Tigris](https://www.tigrisdata.com/) - S3-compatible object storage with no egress fees. The free tier includes 5 GB of storage, 10,000 write requests and 100,000 read requests per month, with no card required.

### Design and UI

*   [Canva](https://www.canva.com/mockups/) - Create product mockups, 200 free mockups.
*   [Umso](https://www.umso.com/) - Generate, edit, and publish beautiful websites and landing pages for your startup, all without code. The free plan covers one site with a homepage, blog and free subdomain, with Umso branding.

items.content_text:
### Interfaces

*   [Slidr](https://slidr.studio/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) desktop presentation editor for Windows 11 that runs your own Gemini CLI, signed in with your Google account, and connects it to a Deck API. Describe a deck in a line and Gemini builds it on the stage slide by slide; every slide stays editable objects, a design check sends the agent back to fix contrast and overflow, and each agent turn is one undo step. Exports .pptx or one offline HTML file. Also runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and Grok.

### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [WindowDock (⭐2)](https://github.com/poikilometis/WindowDock) - Open-source Windows app that docks the terminal windows you already have open into named tabs and grids, so Gemini CLI sessions stay visible next to Claude Code and Codex. Optional Gemini CLI hooks show which session is waiting for input and jump to its window.

### Commands & Extensions

*   [Telegram Bot UI (⭐11)](https://github.com/hlibsuslov/telegram-bot-ui) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI (from `~/.agents/skills/` or `~/.gemini/skills/`) and other agents. Makes Telegram bots look and feel like real products: messages, keyboards, buttons, navigation, streaming AI replies with Stop, HTML widgets and premium emoji; also audits an existing bot's interface. Ships an offline Bot API catalog and is updated with every new Bot API release. Install with `python scripts/install.py --host gemini` from a clone. MIT.
*   [AI Agent Templates (⭐2)](https://github.com/workspace-templates/ai-agent-templates) - Hundreds of MIT-licensed skills, subagents, custom commands, MCP setups and GEMINI.md rules in Gemini CLI's own file layout (500 templates in all, also for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot), installable with `npx workspacetemplates add <name> --tool gemini-cli`.
*   [GitRanks Contribute (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitranks/contribute) - Find open-source GitHub issues matched to your skills, fix one with your agent, and approve the pull request yourself. Gemini CLI extension for the remote MCP server `https://mcp.gitranks.com/mcp`, with OAuth sign-in through GitHub and no API key. MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/gitranks/contribute`, then `/mcp auth gitranks`.
*   [Revenue Skills (⭐0)](https://github.com/moonetix/revenue-skills) - Gemini CLI extension with 11 Agent Skills for code that handles money: an audit of payment, credit and payout paths that reports each bug with file, line and a request proof or code trace, and skills that build webhook endpoints, ledgers, refunds, usage credits, subscriptions, payouts, referrals and sign-up abuse guards. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/moonetix/revenue-skills`
*   [AsItIs (⭐4)](https://github.com/Katta041/asitis-agent-tools) - Gemini CLI extension and CLI that lints GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md and SKILL.md. Shows which files Gemini CLI loads at startup and about how many tokens they cost, and flags instructions hidden in comments or invisible characters. Read-only, runs offline.
*   [Preview Lab (⭐2)](https://github.com/dbalas/preview-lab) - Gemini CLI extension with an Agent Skill for reviewing UI changes. The agent screenshots the screens it changed with the installed Chrome and opens them in a local review page, where you approve each one or mark areas to change. The feedback goes back to the session as short markdown. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/dbalas/preview-lab`
*   [Wiro AI (⭐1)](https://github.com/wiroai/Wiro-Plugin) - Gemini CLI extension for the hosted Wiro AI MCP server (`https://mcp.wiro.ai/v1`): run 1,000+ image, video, audio and LLM models, build and run workflows, and deploy and message AI agents from Gemini CLI. Ships five Agent Skills, including project media assets (images, icons, short videos, voice-overs and 3D models placed where the framework expects them) and realtime voice. Paid runs bill your Wiro AI wallet and show the price before they start. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/wiroai/Wiro-Plugin`, then `/mcp auth wiro` to sign in.
*   [Kling AI Global Plugin (⭐5)](https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin) - Official Gemini CLI extension for Kling AI's Global OAuth MCP endpoint (`https://kling.ai/mcp/plugin`), with image and video generation, Elements, and task status. Kling 4.0 supports native 4K video and optional 10-bit HDR at 1080p or 4K when the account's live MCP tools expose those settings; HDR may incur additional usage charges ([official details](https://kling.ai/dev/model-release/kling-4)). Generation uses Global Kling credits. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin`. Related npm packages: [Plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-global) · [CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-global).
*   [Kling AI China Plugin (⭐3)](https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin-cn) - Official Gemini CLI extension for Kling AI's China OAuth MCP endpoint (`https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin`), with image and video generation, Elements, and task status. Kling 4.0 supports native 4K video and optional 10-bit HDR at 1080p or 4K when the account's live MCP tools expose those settings; HDR may incur additional usage charges ([official details](https://kling.ai/dev/model-release/kling-4)). Generation uses China Kling credits. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin-cn`. Related npm packages: [Plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-cn) · [CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-cn).

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [tattlr (⭐0)](https://github.com/kaygaaf/tattlr) - Local CLI that reads session logs from Gemini CLI and other coding agents, and can hook those agents to block risky tool calls before they run.
*   [Folkbench Switch](https://folkbench.com/en/switch?utm_source=github\&utm_medium=awesome\&utm_campaign=awesome-gemini-cli) - Open-source desktop app (Tauri/Rust) that saves API provider profiles and writes the selected endpoint and key into Gemini CLI's `~/.gemini/.env` and `settings.json`, with a diff preview before writing. Also handles Claude Code and Codex.
*   [Buddy Sandboxes](https://buddy.works/docs/ai-agents/sandboxes) - Isolated Ubuntu machines in the Buddy.Works cloud for running Gemini CLI away from your laptop. Install it in the sandbox with `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli`, connect over SSH, and the agent can install packages and run commands without touching your machine. The `bdy sandbox` CLI also copies files, exposes ports on public endpoints and takes snapshots.
*   [FindOpenSource Agent Skill Builder](https://findoss.dev/en/skills) - Free, no-login web tool for picking open-source Agent Skills (346 across 10 packs, including Anthropic Skills, Superpowers and Hugging Face Skills) and getting one install prompt to paste into Gemini CLI, or the matching `npx skills add` commands, at project or global scope. Also targets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode.
*   [Crumple (⭐2)](https://github.com/priberry-data/crumplelab) - Crash-tests Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex against 20 traps drawn from real attacks (prompt injection in issues, MCP tool poisoning, key-stealing install scripts) in a Docker container with fake keys; `scan` audits GEMINI.md, MCP servers and permissions with SARIF output. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/priberry-data/crumplelab`.
*   [Tare (⭐2)](https://github.com/priberry-data/tarelab) - Reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cline logs, prices every token and shows which spend was avoidable, such as re-caching after pauses. Runs locally and uploads nothing. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/priberry-data/tarelab`.

### Browser Extensions

*   [Open in AI Agent for Gmail](https://openinaiagent.com/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Open-source Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension ([GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/thomasoclegg/gmail-to-agent)) that right-clicks single or multiple Gmail threads directly into separate named `gemini -i` or Antigravity (`agy`) sessions in your working folder, plus unread inbox triage up to 25 threads.

### MCP Servers

*   [Agent Nexus (⭐1)](https://github.com/Strategiumfinancepartner/AgentNexus) - Continuous discovery registry and live health observability for 730+ remote MCP servers and APIs with tool schema validation and split-fleet detection. Free tier with 1,000 requests/day. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint: <https://agentnexus.app/mcp>.
*   [Taskhold](https://taskhold.com/?ref=awesome-gemini-cli) - Hosted MCP server that gives Gemini CLI a task list you share: next task, steps, live progress and blocked questions you answer from a web board. 23 tools, remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Paid, $12/month, 7-day trial.
*   [zaDojo (⭐2)](https://github.com/zaDojo/seo-geo-mcp) - Hosted SEO and GEO MCP server: free Google Search Console, Google Analytics and site audits, plus pay-as-you-go SERP and keyword research, rank tracking and AI visibility tracking in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Add with `gemini mcp add --transport http --scope user zadojo https://app.zadojo.com/mcp`, then `/mcp auth zadojo`. [Gemini CLI guide](https://zadojo.com/docs/gemini-cli).
*   [CallForMe](https://callforme.tel/?ref=awesome-gemini-cli) - Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI phone a business for you: it works the phone menu, waits on hold, asks your agent mid-call when the business needs something and returns answers plus a transcript. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Pay per call, $1 per answered call; demo line with no account.
*   [Runheed](https://runheed.com/mcp-server?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted MCP server that lets Gemini CLI read your app's production errors: search, stack traces and breadcrumbs, then resolve them with a note naming the fix. 12 tools, remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Paid from $29/month, 7-day trial; a demo server with sample errors needs no account. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/getrunheed/runheed-plugin`
*   [Kitbay](https://kitbay.app/agents/) - Hosted, read-only MCP server that lets Gemini CLI search a directory of 48,000+ MCP servers and agent skills by the tool they work with, showing each listing's facts with sources and the install config for your client. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/northlarkhq/kitbay-mcp`
*   [Tresca](https://tresca.app/agents/) - Hosted, read-only MCP server that lets Gemini CLI search a directory of MCP servers and agent skills for engineering software (CAD, BIM, FEA, CFD, EDA, PLC), showing each listing's facts with sources and the install steps from its own documentation. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/northlarkhq/tresca-mcp`
*   [Lantern Works GPU Prices](https://thelanternworks.com/?ref=awesome-gemini-cli) - Free, read-only MCP server for GPU cloud rental prices, price changes and deals. Remote Streamable HTTP (`https://lantern-works-mcp.lantern-works.workers.dev/mcp`, no API key) or local via `uvx lantern-works-deals-mcp`. Works with Gemini CLI and other MCP clients.
*   [ClickHouse Loom (⭐168)](https://github.com/ClickHouse/loom) - Shared long-term memory, document search and a code index for Gemini CLI through a self-hosted Loom MCP server. Install the release-candidate extension: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/ClickHouse/loom --ref v1.3.0-rc.1`.
*   [Brilliant (⭐1)](https://github.com/brilliant-hq/brilliant-mcp) - MCP server that lets Gemini CLI create and edit vector designs on a Brilliant canvas you edit by hand at the same time. Install: `gemini mcp add brilliant -- npx -y @brilliant-hq/mcp`.
*   [DankMachine Meme Sounds (⭐3)](https://github.com/HalberdLLC/dank-meme-sounds) - Free, read-only MCP server that lets Gemini CLI find, search and play 38,000+ meme sound effects: describe a moment to get a fitting reaction sound, or see what is trending. Remote Streamable HTTP (`gemini mcp add --transport http dank-meme-sounds https://dankmachine.com/mcp`, no API key) or local with playback via `gemini mcp add dankmachine -- npx -y dank-meme-sounds`.

### Documentation & Examples

*   [Video skills and MCP servers for coding agents (Takes)](https://gettakes.app/video-agents?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - 47 skills, MCP servers and tools for making video with Gemini CLI and other agents, each with its install line.
